name: -8 AN to M16x1.5mm Inverted Flare Adapter (w/ O-Ring)
title: -8 AN to M16x1.5mm Inverted Flare Adapter (w/ O-Ring)
description:
The -8 AN to M16x1.5mm Inverted Flare Adapter (w/ O-Ring) is engineered for demanding high-performance automotive fluid systems. ColorFittings Inverted Flare Adapters are precision-engineered to connect AN flare fittings to inverted flare ports, providing a secure, leak-free solution for brake, fuel, oil, and power steering plumbing systems.

Technical Specifications:
• Origin: Precision CNC-machined in the USA.
• Material & Finish: 6061-T6 Billet Aluminum with an anodized finish for maximum corrosion resistance.
